import re

def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    """Check if given string is a palindrome ignoring non-alphanumeric characters."""
    sanitized = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', text).lower()
    return sanitized == sanitized[::-1]

from pathlib import Path

def analyze_word_frequency(filepath: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Read file and return dictionary of word counts."""
    content = Path(filepath).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    words = content.lower().split()
    return dict(Counter(words))

from collections import Counter
from typing import Any, List, Optional

def get_most_frequent_element(items: List[Any]) -> Optional[Any]:
    """Find and return the most commonly occurring element in the list."""
    if not items:
        return None
    return Counter(items).most_common(1)[0][0]
